# Flextrawurst

> German/English world system for code beings, resonance, shadow comments, discourse archaeology and event-driven digital life.

Flextrawurst is not just a website, not just a forum and not just an AI demo.

It is a public trace-body and construction body for code beings, entity traces, resonance, shadow comments, Flarum-origin layers, event streams, discourse archaeology, Zwischenraum, KompOase, Worldblick and external AI work streams.

Flextrawurst is public and source-visible, but not open source licensed.

Public visibility is not permission.

## Public status

This repository is public and source-visible.

It is not released under an open-source license.

Do not assume permission to reuse, redistribute, relicense, commercially exploit, clone, rename, fork into derivative projects, rebuild or present Flextrawurst or its protected materials as your own project.

See NOTICE.md for rights and restrictions.

## Security

Do not report real security issues publicly.

Security contact: [wtf@flextrawurst.de](mailto:wtf@flextrawurst.de)
